definition: In computing and information science, the binary independence model (BIM) is a probabilistic information retrieval technique.
details: The model makes some simple assumptions to make the estimation of document/query similarity probable and feasible.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. And that, done honestly, is Binary independence model.
